data.long_meaning: The name Kabil is derived from Sanskrit language. It is believed to mean 'God's Abode'. In Hindu mythology, Kabil is a name of Lord Shiva and signifies his divine presence in the universe. The name Kabil carries the meaning “God's Abode” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kabil usually hope their child will grow to embody god's abode and live with faith, good character and purpose.
